title: Insurance Document Analysis
summary: This document is an insurance policy issued by Synthetic Insurance to Casey Example, effective January 1, 2:00 PM, 2026, and expiring December 31, 2026. It covers inpatient hospital treatment up to RM50,000 per month with a monthly premium of RM250. Pre-existing conditions are excluded from coverage.
plainLanguageExplanation:
The insured person is Casey Example, who is the policyholder responsible for paying the premium and receiving coverage under this insurance policy.

The premium is RM250 per month, which the insured person must pay to maintain coverage under this policy.

Coverage includes inpatient hospital treatment up to RM50,000 per month, meaning the insurer will pay for hospital costs within this limit if the insured person is hospitalized.

Pre-existing conditions are excluded from coverage, meaning any health issues the insured person had before the policy started are not covered by this insurance.
